justification: Progress documentation already exists in fragments: recurring Stories, Highlights, fitness apps like Strava, and YouTube progress vlogs. People even hand-curate Highlights into makeshift journeys, which proves the appetite. But that appetite is for DISPLAYING grouped progress - a low-effort, static act - while Journeys asks for sustained active posting, a higher bar; and Highlights itself is widely abandoned. So the behavior is proven only in part, which is why this is a 4, not a 5.

Journeys lives inside Instagram itself: on the profile, surfaced in-feed to opt-in followers, with entry points from Explore (Reels entry is a deliberately later-phase move). Maximum surface leverage - the strongest discriminating trait in the launch data - and with Instagram now demoting Highlights off the profile, there is an open lane for a better embedded progress format to occupy.
Built on the Instagram follow graph plus a low-cost 'follow along' opt-in that lets non-followers join a single Journey. Strong graph leverage, the other top discriminating trait.

axis: New-behavior adoption cost (lower cost = higher score)
justification: Starting a Journey and posting repeatedly is a new, higher-commitment habit, so this stays mid-scored. But several design choices actively lower the cost: users can opt in at creation to be reminded to post on the timeline they themselves set (reminders are off by default, so the feature never nags); potential WhatsApp-group integration lets a Journey's updates flow to an existing accountability group; and as Journeys accumulate views and follow-alongs, the social reward of attention makes posting the next update more compelling rather than a chore.

Monetization is intentionally staged, which is why this is mid-scored rather than low. Journeys launches with NO sponsored content - it first generates high-intent targeting signals and proves the guidance layer is useful. Only once the feature is proven does it introduce clearly-labeled sponsored products and businesses matched to a user's stage (gear for a golf Journey, vendors for a wedding). The path is deliberate and trust-preserving, but because the larger commerce/creator revenue is deferred, near-term clarity is moderate.
